svg.title: The pad Ps occurs once in each term; only the residual −Es is raised to the power n. This follows from GsPs = I + Es, hence G−1 s = Ps(I + Es)−1. Each diagonal summand is continuous in s and bounded in absolute value by (Q + 1)payE · ρn. The geometric bound is summable independently of s. Hence its interval integrals may be summed:
